senses.zh: 鲑鱼（肉）；三文鱼（肉）；大麻哈鱼（肉）
senses.en: (pl. salmon)
examples: The [[salmon]] swim upstream to spawn in late summer or fall.

senses.en: (infml.) a close friend
examples: Margherita and I have been [[pals]] since we were at primary school.

senses.en: (always + ad. / prep.) move very quickly and lightly, like a small animal
examples: Shaking the snow off their hair and coats, the girls [[skittered]] up the stairs into the house.

senses.en: (esp. AmE) a wide main road that joins one town to another
examples: The interstate [[highways]] are usually faster, but smaller roads can be more scenic (景色优美的).

senses.zh: （机器或玩具）装有发条的，用手柄操作的
senses.en: (BrE wind-up) (only before noun) relating to a machine or toy that you turn part of several times, in order to make it move or start working
examples: Directly in front of him were two [[windup]] monkeys, one with a guitar and the other with a drum.

senses.en: (of liquid or small bits) quickly scatter through the air
examples: The water [[sprayed]] from the hose (水龙带) and onto the grassland.
Someone had [[sprayed]] blue paint all over his car.

senses.en: force liquid out of a container so that it comes out in a stream of very small drops and covers an area
examples: The water [[sprayed]] from the hose (水龙带) and onto the grassland.
Someone had [[sprayed]] blue paint all over his car.

senses.en: (always + ad. / prep.) fall or drop heavily
examples: I finally got home and [[flopped]] down on the bed.

senses.en: concerning or produced by magnetism
examples: Pigeons navigate less accurately when the Earth's [[magnetic]] field is disturbed.

senses.zh: 不幸地（表示但愿并非如此）
senses.en: (fml.) used when mentioning a fact that you wish was not true
examples: Donald, [[alas]], died last winter, even though he had shown signs of recovery for a while.

senses.en: a process in which you put sth. into the group or class it belongs to
examples: The [[classification]] of books in the library helps you find the books you want.

senses.en: (pl. rainbow trout or rainbow trouts)
in a very beautiful and delicate way
examples: She could not take her eyes away from the [[exquisitely]] charming portrait.

senses.zh: 岩石覆盖的；由岩石形成的
senses.en: covered with rocks or made of rock
examples: The small village sits on a [[rocky]] hill overlooking the sea.

senses.zh: 奥米伽3（一组多元不饱和脂肪酸）

senses.en: a food that is needed and used all the time
examples: The aid workers are distributing corn, milk, vegetables, and other [[staples]].

senses.en: produce eggs in large quantities at the same time
examples: The salmon swim upstream to [[spawn]] in late summer or fall.
New technology has [[spawned]] new business opportunities.

senses.zh: 使大量出现；使大量生产；酿成
senses.en: make a series of things happen or start to exist
examples: The salmon swim upstream to [[spawn]] in late summer or fall.
New technology has [[spawned]] new business opportunities.

senses.en: (pl. cod)

senses.zh: （计划或行动）发生意外，产生事与愿违的结果
senses.en: (of a plan or action) have the opposite effect to the one you intended
examples: The company's new policy [[backfired]] when a number of employees threatened to quit.

senses.en: (only before noun) in the sea or on the land near the coast
examples: This kind of fish is found worldwide in tropical oceans, at the edge of [[coastal]] waters and in the open sea.

senses.zh: 茁壮成长；兴旺；欣欣向荣
senses.en: become very strong and healthy or very successful
examples: It is still unclear whether these companies will continue to [[thrive]] in the future.

senses.en: a large quantity of sth.
examples: One quality that the team possessed in [[abundance]] was fighting spirit.

senses.en: sth. that improves your life, helps you in some way, or makes you happy
examples: This modern medical equipment allows patients to live a more normal life, which is a real [[blessing]].

senses.en: the state of containing a lot of fat
examples: With much protein but little [[fattiness]], beef is the healthy food sought by many people.

senses.en: slightly wet, esp. in a way that is pleasant or suitable
examples: This fruit cake will keep [[moist]] for several days if it is stored in the refrigerator.

senses.en: cook food for too long
examples: A customer complained that the vegetables were [[overcooked]].

senses.en: cook sth., such as meat, in an oven or over a fire, or cook in this way
examples: I personally would rather [[roast]] a chicken whole.

senses.zh: 剩余；过剩；剩余额；多余的量
senses.en: an amount of sth. that is more than what is needed or used
examples: This country produces more oil than it needs and sells the [[surplus]] to the rest of the world.

senses.en: include sth. as part of a group, system, plan, etc.
examples: We've [[incorporated]] many environmentally friendly features into the design of the building.

senses.en: (BrE also avocado pear) (pl. avocados)
the activity of deciding how to advertise a product, what price to charge for it, etc., or the type of job in which you do this
examples: The reason their cars sold so well was that they had a brilliant [[marketing]] strategy.

senses.en: (overtook, overtaken) develop or increase more quickly than sb. / sth. else and become more successful, more important, or more advanced than them
examples: Television soon [[overtook]] the cinema as the most popular form of entertainment.

senses.en: weak or uncertain, and likely to become worse under pressure
examples: This area has a range of [[fragile]] ecosystems and rare plants.

senses.en: (of animals or plants) brought or kept under control or cultivation
examples: A [[domesticated]] animal, accustomed to being fed by hand, may not be able to live without man.

senses.en: a particular type of animal that is different from others but not so different that it is another species
examples: What [[breed]] of dog is that? I've never seen one like it before.
Many animals [[breed]] only at certain times of the year.

senses.en: (of animals) mate in order to have babies
examples: What [[breed]] of dog is that? I've never seen one like it before.
Many animals [[breed]] only at certain times of the year.

senses.zh: 驾车兜风（尤其偷来别人汽车进行危险驾驶）
senses.en: an act of driving around for enjoyment in a car, esp. one that was taken without permission and is driven in a dangerous manner
examples: A police spokesman said the incident appeared to have been a [[joyride]].

senses.zh: 利用 , 发掘，开发（已有的能源、知识等）
senses.en: make use of a source of energy, knowledge, etc. that already exists
examples: She hopes that additional sources of educational funding can be [[tapped into]] to help the poor children.

senses.zh: 简明恰当的；简洁中肯的
senses.en: dealing only with the important subject or idea, and not including any unnecessary discussions
examples: Her comments on the current issues were brief and to the point.

senses.en: (fml.) mostly
examples: Their success was due [[in large part]] to their ability to speak Spanish.

senses.en: be suitable for being used in a particular way
examples: None of his books really [[lends itself to]] being made into a film.

senses.zh: （为了节约时间、金钱或精力而）马虎从事
senses.en: save time, money, or energy by doing things quickly and not as carefully as you should
examples: There's a temptation to [[cut corners]] when you're pushed for time, but it's not worth it.

senses.en: gradually stop using or providing sth.
examples: It is highly probable that the subsidy for car manufactures is to be [[phased out]] next year.

senses.en: (spoken) said when giving your opinion
examples: Well, [[in my book]], if you steal, you deserve to get caught.

哈得孙河（主要位于美国纽约州内）

senses.en: /meɪn/

senses.zh: 斯堪的纳维亚（欧洲西北部文化区，包括挪威、瑞典和丹麦，有时也包括冰岛、芬兰和法罗群岛）
皮吉特湾（位于美国华盛顿州）
